text:
Priya Choudhury: heads-up, discovered a weird parity bug between our python and node SDKs on resume headers for SSE. sampleapp iOS repro shows duplicate events after reconnect.
Alex Martinez: repro steps?
Priya Choudhury: Steps: 1) start sampleapp streaming (python SDK backend) 2) flip network for ~200ms 3) reconnect -> python sends header 'last-event-id' while node sends 'Last-Event-Id'. server seems to only accept one casing and we end up with duplicate last token processing.
Sasha: that casing difference should be normalized by server per spec, but maybe our proxy lowercases then reconstructs differently. can you paste request/response logs?
Priya Choudhury: pasted minimal repro logs: 
```
# client reconnect (curl mimic)
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.test
> Last-Event-ID: 1678-abc
> Accept: text/event-stream

# server access log
127.0.0.1 - - [23/Mar/2026:12:10:01 +0000] "GET /v1/stream" 200 - "-" "python-sdk/1.4"
# downstream internal router shows header as: last-event-id: 1678-abc
# but resume token check looked for header key 'Last-Event-ID' and skipped resume flow
```
Dan L: ouch. where is the check? high chance the resume check is doing a case-sensitive lookup in net/http header map in our Go router. net/http canonicalizes keys but some intermediate layer (envoy filter) might be rewriting.
kevin: i remember we intentionally added a compatibility shim for older browsers to set both X-Last-Event-Id and Last-Event-Id in node SDK. maybe python only sets lowercase.
Priya Choudhury: confirmed: python SDK uses requests and does headers = {"last-event-id": token}. node SDK sets both.
Alex Martinez: quick mitigation: server should .Get("Last-Event-Id") and fallback to strings.ToLower map. but longer term sdk parity fix: both sdks should include canonical header.
Sasha: agree. also add an integration test that simulates envoy header normalization. we should also cover mobile sampleapps that use EventSource polyfill (they may rely on Last-Event-ID vs last-event-id).
Priya Choudhury: created minimal PR draft in sampleapp: set both header spellings on reconnect. repro branch: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/42 (WIP).
ci-bot: build #3421 triggered for branch sampleapp/sse-header-fix.
Dan L: also add a small middleware in go router to normalize header keys into a single canonical field for resume token. I'll open a PR for that on platform/router.
kevin: can we add a tiny e2e that does: start stream -> inject network flap -> verify only one resume and no duplicated final token? would catch regressions.
Alex Martinez: yep. Priya, can you add the e2e to sampleapp CI and mark flaky guard?
Priya Choudhury: on it, will add test + note in release notes under devex breaking changes.
Sasha: thanks all. follow-up: let's also audit other headers we rely on for parity (X-Request-ID, X-Resume-Token) to ensure both sdks and proxies agree on casing. :mag:
